Maya: Plan: small three-way change at 23:00 UTC — runtime v2.4.2 (kv tweak), API header alias, console pin. Goal: low-risk header rename + perf patch. Any objections?

Sam: API ok. I'll accept both header names and add a short compatibility proxy. Will keep logs for header usage.

Cheng: Runtime: v2.4.2 fixes a batching edgecase. Recommend 2% canary for 12m then 30% for 8m. Watch p95 and kv.evictions.

DeployBot: Canary deployed to shard s-14 at 2% traffic. Auto-rollback: errors>0.5% for 5m OR p95>baseline*1.3 for 5m.

Leo: Console will pin ui-schema v1.8 and add a feature toggle expose for header mode.

Anita: Oncall here. I'll add alerts for p95, error-rate, eviction-rate and route pages to SRE. Also confirm request header capture for 5xx.

Maya: Rollback checklist: 1) deploybot rollback runtime v2.4.1 2) API revert header acceptance 3) keep console pin 4) notify customers if >15m degradation.

DeployBot: Canary metrics @ +4m: errors=0.08%, p95 +6%. No alerts.

Cheng: Good. Tailing eviction logs. No spikes.

Anita: Dashboards green. Holding until ramp decision at +12m.

Maya: Thanks. If anyone sees anomalies ping in-thread and call rollback.
